original.statement: The MirrorMaker2 example Grafana dashboard was improved to set metric units and include chart descriptions; no operational consequence is stated.

decision.reason: [ev-52ec3b963cc5] only says the example MirrorMaker2 Grafana dashboard now sets metric units and includes chart descriptions. It doesn't say anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. This is a presentation change to an example artifact, so "none" (informational, low severity) fits. A failure kind or behavior-change would claim more than the evidence supports.
